notes.title: Utility for the Soul - Soundtrack
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the release of an original [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227850/Utility_for_the_Soul_Soundtrack/]Utility for the Soul game soundtrack[/url], composed by architect and musician [url=https://ceponis.bandcamp.com/]Ignas Čeponis[/url]! He presents 18 minutes of minimalist atmospheric soundscapes featured in 5 tracks crafted to relieve the overworked employees of the enlightened corporations:

[olist]
[*] - In the Desert (Main Theme) - 2:07
[*] - Earth - 4:37
[*] - Fire - 4:24
[*] - Water - 4:18
[*] - Air - 3:14

[/olist]Ignas has imagined a soundscape of the Retreat House facility according to the original technical notes left by [url=https://www.kasubaworks.com/]Aleksandra Kasuba[/url] the author of the 1970s Utility for the Soul concept book. You can also find these notes in the game before every new level (bottom left):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067561/b4d0980c1f816771af6b24bfc0a4b25deb99b5d1.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The mini album is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227850/Utility_for_the_Soul_Soundtrack/]available on Steam[/url] for [b]Eur/$ 1.99[/b] as a symbolic support for the author.
[*] You can also listen to the soundtrack for free on the most popular [url=https://li.sten.to/utility-for-the-soul]online music platforms[/url].
[/list]

Don't hesitate and take a listen!

- Weekend Warriors
